content: .{@-चक्षुस्@} {%a.%} .²1 having divine vision, heavenly-eyed; त्वया नियम्या ननु दिव्यचक्षुषा <ls>R. 3. 45</ls>. .²2 blind. --({%m.%}) .²1 a monkey. .²2 an Astrologer. .²3 Arjuna. .²4 one who has prophetic vision; दिव्यचक्षुर्ज्योतिषिके पार्थात्मज्ञानिनोरपि <ls>Nm.</ls> --({%n.%}) a divine or prophetic eye, supernatural vision, the power of seeing what is invisible by the human eye.
